metadata.title: Rigidity of shrinking Ricci solitons with low-dimensional focal sets
authors: Matheus Andrade Ribeiro de Moura Horácio
metadata.abstract: We prove that, in every dimension, the focal set of the potential function of a complete gradient shrinking Ricci soliton with constant scalar curvature is totally geodesic whenever it has dimension two or three, and that every complete five-dimensional gradient shrinking Ricci soliton with constant scalar curvature is rigid. The first result follows from a Bochner identity for the covariant derivative of the Ricci tensor at the focal set. For the second, when the scalar curvature is twice the soliton constant, we prove that total geodesy implies rigidity through an integral identity on the level hypersurfaces; the case of scalar curvature three times the soliton constant is treated by a separate argument. As further applications, we combine our methods with the rigidity theorem in the recent preprint of Li, Li, Ou, Qu, Wu and Zhou to obtain rigidity in arbitrary dimension when the scalar curvature is twice or three times the soliton constant, and under integral Weyl pinching for four-dimensional focal sets.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 常标量曲率收缩Ricci孤立子刚性
analysis.workSummary: 在完整梯度收缩Ricci孤立子且标量曲率R=kλ为常数的设置中，作者证明非恒定势函数的最小集在k=2或3时全测地；并独立处理五维剩余标量曲率情形，得到所有完整连通五维常标量曲率收缩子刚性。刚性指Einstein因子与欧氏因子的适当有限商，而不要求整个度量为Einstein。
techniques: 在势函数焦点集上推导Ricci协变导数的Bochner积分恒等式
利用第二基本形式的Weitzenböck及低维代数恒等式消去误差
五维结合势等值超曲面的积分、Gauss–Bonnet与独立分情况论证
analysis.breakthrough: 将低维焦点集的全测地性作为结构性切入点，五维结论不依赖文中最新的外部刚性预印本；结合该外部定理后，才进一步得到任意维R=2λ、3λ及某些四维焦点集Weyl夹持下的刚性。
analysis.limitations: 常标量曲率、完整性及收缩型假设不可省略；全测地焦点集不在本文所有维数中独立等价于刚性。任意维推广明确调用Li等六人的新预印本，四维焦点集还需所列积分Weyl条件，不能改写为一般维Cao猜想已全部解决。已读第1–3页主结论和依赖范围，未独立复核后续积分证明或外部预印本。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第5页披露公开LLM用于求和平方积分恒等式系数、指标计算的计算机代数验证、§5标准线性代数恒等式、按作者要求把既有单调性论证适配Theorem7.1，以及广泛文献搜索与校对。作者说明全文和论证由自己写并核查。适配既有证明记proofs，符号运算及检查记computation/verification；没有具体核心思想AI归因。
